::: {.callout-note}
## Learn by improving passive acoustics data streams

1. Choose a scenario that matches a Current State acoustic data pipeline.
2. Compare baseline queues with Future State pull signals and automated metadata feeds.
3. Review how AI pre-screening can focus analyst validation targets.
4. When you are ready, [open the interactive builder](./future-primary.qmd) to load your Current State files and design your own map.
:::

## Explore three Future State passive acoustics pipelines

These simplified NOAA Fisheries Passive Acoustics Research examples build on the bottom-mounted mooring, mobile glider, and towed hydrophone workflows in the Current State tutorial. They show how automated ingestion, AI pre-screening, targeted analyst validation, and automated metadata feeds can improve acoustic data streams.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof future_example_tutorial = {
  const future_example_scenarios = {
    moorings: {
      label: "Long-Term Bottom-Mounted Moorings (e.g., HARP / PAMGuard)",
      summary:
        "Transition from manual drive shipping and 100% visual inspection to automated cloud ingestion, AI pre-screening, and targeted analyst validation.",
      current_steps: ["Drive Ingest", "AI Detection", "100% Analyst Review", "NCEI Archiving"],
      future_steps: ["Auto Cloud Ingest", "AI Pre-Screening", "Targeted Audit", "NCEI Archiving"],
      current_queues: ["12 TB drive backlog", "18 TB detector queue", "46 TB review backlog"],
      future_signals: ["Automated trigger", "Low-confidence pull", "Auto-schema pass"],
      metrics: [
        ["Analyst Review", "Process time (hr / TB)", 6.5, 1.2],
        ["AI Detection", "First-pass accuracy (%C/A)", 78, 92],
        ["Total Pipeline", "Lead time (days)", 62.5, 11.5],
        ["Total Pipeline", "Value-added time (hr / TB)", 9.05, 3.75],
        ["Quality", "Metadata error rate (%)", 7.5, 0.5]
      ]
    },
    gliders: {
      label: "Autonomous Mobile Gliders & AUVs",
      summary:
        "Streamline acoustic timestamps and flight telemetry synchronization through containerized scripts and automated soundscape extraction.",
      current_steps: ["Manual GPS Sync", "Soundscape Ingest", "Deep Learning AI", "Product Review"],
      future_steps: ["Auto Telemetry Sync", "Streamed Ingestion", "Deep Learning AI", "Auto-Product Gen"],
      current_queues: ["8 surveys pending sync", "5 datasets queued", "3 report reviews"],
      future_signals: ["Auto-log match", "Continuous buffer", "Single-click sign-off"],
      metrics: [
        ["GPS Sync", "Lead time (days)", 5.0, 0.5],
        ["Product Review", "Lead time (days)", 3.0, 0.5],
        ["Total Pipeline", "Lead time (days)", 11.5, 2.5],
        ["Total Pipeline", "Value-added time (hr / TB)", 4.6, 3.1],
        ["Quality", "Sync error rate (%)", 14, 1]
      ]
    },
    towed_arrays: {
      label: "Towed Hydrophone Survey Arrays",
      summary:
        "Reduce vessel post-cruise processing backlogs by deploying automated bearing trackers and standardized commercial hardware components.",
      current_steps: ["Vessel Real-Time", "Manual Bearing Verify", "Track QA/QC", "Stock Report Entry"],
      future_steps: ["Vessel Real-Time", "Auto 3D Localization", "Targeted QA/QC", "Auto NetCDF Entry"],
      current_queues: ["14 cruise legs pending", "120 hr audio backlog", "6 track files queued"],
      future_signals: ["Vessel auto-upload", "High-uncertainty pull", "Validated NetCDF feed"],
      metrics: [
        ["Bearing Verify", "Process time (hr / hr audio)", 3.5, 0.8],
        ["Track QA/QC", "Lead time (days)", 4.0, 1.0],
        ["Total Pipeline", "Lead time (days)", 19.0, 3.5],
        ["Total Pipeline", "Value-added time (hr / hr audio)", 5.7, 2.2],
        ["Quality", "Tracking hold rate (%)", 15, 2]
      ]
    }
  };

  const future_example_root = document.createElement("div");
  future_example_root.className = "future-example-tutorial";
  const future_example_control = document.createElement("div");
  future_example_control.className = "future-example-control";
  const future_example_label = document.createElement("label");
  future_example_label.htmlFor = "future-example-scenario";
  future_example_label.textContent = "Example scenario";
  const future_example_select = document.createElement("select");
  future_example_select.id = "future-example-scenario";
  for (const [future_example_key, future_example_scenario] of Object.entries(
    future_example_scenarios
  )) {
    const future_example_option = document.createElement("option");
    future_example_option.value = future_example_key;
    future_example_option.textContent = future_example_scenario.label;
    future_example_select.append(future_example_option);
  }
  const future_example_status = document.createElement("span");
  future_example_status.className = "future-example-status";
  future_example_status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  future_example_control.append(
    future_example_label,
    future_example_select,
    future_example_status
  );
  const future_example_content = document.createElement("div");
  future_example_content.className = "future-example-tutorial";
  future_example_root.append(future_example_control, future_example_content);

  const future_example_svg_namespace = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  function future_example_svg_element(future_example_name, future_example_attributes) {
    const future_example_element = document.createElementNS(
      future_example_svg_namespace,
      future_example_name
    );
    for (const [future_example_attribute, future_example_value] of Object.entries(
      future_example_attributes
    )) {
      future_example_element.setAttribute(future_example_attribute, future_example_value);
    }
    return future_example_element;
  }

  function future_example_render_map(
    future_example_title_text,
    future_example_steps,
    future_example_connections,
    future_example_is_future
  ) {
    const future_example_card = document.createElement("article");
    future_example_card.className = "future-example-map-card";
    const future_example_heading = document.createElement("h4");
    future_example_heading.textContent = future_example_title_text;
    const future_example_map = document.createElement("div");
    future_example_map.className = "future-example-map";
    const future_example_svg = future_example_svg_element("svg", {
      viewBox: "0 0 700 235",
      role: "img",
      "aria-label": `${future_example_title_text} process flow`
    });
    const future_example_svg_title = future_example_svg_element("title", {});
    future_example_svg_title.textContent = `${future_example_title_text} process flow`;
    future_example_svg.append(future_example_svg_title);

    const future_example_marker_id = future_example_is_future
      ? "future-example-target-arrow"
      : "future-example-baseline-arrow";
    const future_example_marker = future_example_svg_element("marker", {
      id: future_example_marker_id,
      markerWidth: "10",
      markerHeight: "10",
      refX: "8",
      refY: "3",
      orient: "auto",
      markerUnits: "strokeWidth"
    });
    const future_example_arrow = future_example_svg_element("path", {
      d: "M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z",
      fill: "currentColor"
    });
    future_example_marker.append(future_example_arrow);
    const future_example_defs = future_example_svg_element("defs", {});
    future_example_defs.append(future_example_marker);
    future_example_svg.append(future_example_defs);

    future_example_steps.forEach((future_example_step, future_example_index) => {
      const future_example_x = 15 + future_example_index * 175;
      if (future_example_index > 0) {
        const future_example_line = future_example_svg_element("line", {
          x1: String(future_example_x - 48),
          y1: "77",
          x2: String(future_example_x - 10),
          y2: "77",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          "stroke-width": "3",
          "marker-end": `url(#${future_example_marker_id})`
        });
        const future_example_connection = future_example_svg_element("text", {
          x: String(future_example_x - 30),
          y: "145",
          "text-anchor": "middle",
          fill: "currentColor",
          "font-size": "13"
        });
        future_example_connection.textContent =
          future_example_connections[future_example_index - 1];
        future_example_svg.append(future_example_line, future_example_connection);
      }

      const future_example_box = future_example_svg_element("rect", {
        x: String(future_example_x),
        y: "38",
        width: "135",
        height: "78",
        rx: "8",
        fill: future_example_is_future ? "#dcfce7" : "#e8f1fb",
        stroke: future_example_is_future ? "#287a46" : "#245b8a",
        "stroke-width": "2"
      });
      const future_example_name = future_example_svg_element("text", {
        x: String(future_example_x + 67.5),
        y: "71",
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        fill: future_example_is_future ? "#174c2b" : "#16324a",
        "font-size": "14",
        "font-weight": "700"
      });
      const future_example_words = future_example_step.split(" ");
      const future_example_split = Math.ceil(future_example_words.length / 2);
      const future_example_first = future_example_svg_element("tspan", {
        x: String(future_example_x + 67.5),
        dy: "0"
      });
      const future_example_second = future_example_svg_element("tspan", {
        x: String(future_example_x + 67.5),
        dy: "19"
      });
      future_example_first.textContent =
        future_example_words.slice(0, future_example_split).join(" ");
      future_example_second.textContent =
        future_example_words.slice(future_example_split).join(" ");
      future_example_name.append(future_example_first);
      if (future_example_second.textContent) {
        future_example_name.append(future_example_second);
      }
      future_example_svg.append(future_example_box, future_example_name);

    });

    const future_example_legend = future_example_svg_element("text", {
      x: "15",
      y: "205",
      fill: "currentColor",
      "font-size": "14"
    });
    future_example_legend.textContent = future_example_is_future
      ? "Target pull signals appear below the arrows."
      : "Baseline queues appear below the arrows and expose waiting work.";
    future_example_svg.append(future_example_legend);
    future_example_map.append(future_example_svg);
    future_example_card.append(future_example_heading, future_example_map);
    return future_example_card;
  }

  function future_example_render_metrics(future_example_scenario) {
    const future_example_section = document.createElement("section");
    future_example_section.className = "future-example-panel";
    const future_example_heading = document.createElement("h3");
    future_example_heading.textContent = "Future target metadata";
    const future_example_help = document.createElement("p");
    future_example_help.textContent =
      "Use the Current State values as a reference and record targets with the same units.";
    const future_example_grid = document.createElement("div");
    future_example_grid.className = "future-example-metric-grid";

    const future_example_groups = new Map();
    for (const future_example_metric of future_example_scenario.metrics) {
      const [future_example_component] = future_example_metric;
      if (!future_example_groups.has(future_example_component)) {
        future_example_groups.set(future_example_component, []);
      }
      future_example_groups.get(future_example_component).push(future_example_metric);
    }

    for (const [future_example_component, future_example_metrics] of future_example_groups) {
      const future_example_card = document.createElement("article");
      future_example_card.className = "future-example-metric-card";
      const future_example_title = document.createElement("h4");
      future_example_title.textContent = future_example_component;
      const future_example_table = document.createElement("table");
      const future_example_head = document.createElement("thead");
      const future_example_head_row = document.createElement("tr");
      for (const future_example_text of ["Metric", "Baseline", "Target"]) {
        const future_example_cell = document.createElement("th");
        future_example_cell.scope = "col";
        future_example_cell.textContent = future_example_text;
        future_example_head_row.append(future_example_cell);
      }
      future_example_head.append(future_example_head_row);
      const future_example_body = document.createElement("tbody");
      for (const [
        ,
        future_example_metric_name,
        future_example_baseline,
        future_example_target
      ] of future_example_metrics) {
        const future_example_row = document.createElement("tr");
        const future_example_values = [
          future_example_metric_name,
          String(future_example_baseline),
          String(future_example_target)
        ];
        future_example_values.forEach((future_example_value) => {
          const future_example_cell = document.createElement("td");
          future_example_cell.textContent = future_example_value;
          future_example_row.append(future_example_cell);
        });
        future_example_body.append(future_example_row);
      }
      future_example_table.append(future_example_head, future_example_body);
      future_example_card.append(future_example_title, future_example_table);
      future_example_grid.append(future_example_card);
    }
    future_example_section.append(
      future_example_heading,
      future_example_help,
      future_example_grid
    );
    return future_example_section;
  }

  function future_example_render() {
    const future_example_scenario =
      future_example_scenarios[future_example_select.value];
    const future_example_intro = document.createElement("section");
    future_example_intro.className = "future-example-panel";
    const future_example_heading = document.createElement("h3");
    future_example_heading.textContent = future_example_scenario.label;
    const future_example_summary = document.createElement("p");
    future_example_summary.textContent = future_example_scenario.summary;
    const future_example_maps = document.createElement("div");
    future_example_maps.className = "future-example-map-grid";
    future_example_maps.append(
      future_example_render_map(
        "Current State baseline",
        future_example_scenario.current_steps,
        future_example_scenario.current_queues,
        false
      ),
      future_example_render_map(
        "Future State design",
        future_example_scenario.future_steps,
        future_example_scenario.future_signals,
        true
      )
    );
    future_example_intro.append(
      future_example_heading,
      future_example_summary,
      future_example_maps
    );
    future_example_content.replaceChildren(
      future_example_intro,
      future_example_render_metrics(future_example_scenario)
    );
    future_example_status.textContent =
      `Showing ${future_example_scenario.label}.`;
  }

  future_example_select.addEventListener("change", future_example_render);
  future_example_render();
  return future_example_root;
}
```

## Prepare the passive acoustics Gap Analysis inputs

The Future State workspace exports the target metadata shown in these examples as `future-primary.csv`. Preserve it with `current_state_metadata.csv` in `output/`; the upcoming **Gap Analysis** section uses both files to calculate variances in acoustic data streams. Improvement experiments are planned later in the dedicated **Kaizen Experiments** section.

## Take the walkthrough into the builder

1. Export the `.drawio` diagram and timestamped metadata CSV from the [Current State builder](./current-primary.qmd), then keep both files in `output/`.
2. Open the Future State builder and load the `.drawio` file as the visual baseline for the acoustic data stream.
3. Load the Current State CSV; the latest timestamped record for each component becomes its baseline for analyst validation targets.
4. Redesign the flow with AI pre-screening, targeted validation, and automated metadata feeds, and enter targets in the same units as their baselines.
5. Save the target history, then export the revised map and `future-primary.csv` to `output/`.
